gen-gf-bellota-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Distinctive in a hand-traced way, Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine and keeps one stylus width throughout. Be Vietnam Pro is the tidier partner, with strokes like bent steel rod and a mean line set high.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-epilogue: Epilogue is a sans-serif with curvy, unclamped letters and stubby ascender tips. Bellota, the display heading, counters with a hand-traced look, every stroke drawn at the width of a single stylus.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-fira-sans: Commanding without being heavy, Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine and draws every stroke with one stylus. Fira Sans, a sans-serif with a larger-than-usual x-height and no thick-thin contrast, gives that quirk a sturdy floor.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans stands tall, its lowercase making words look sturdy and large, while Bellota above it keeps a blunt round-tip marker feel. Merriweather Sans carries the text with an e that opens clearly to the right, so a long passage keeps moving.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-public-sans: Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine, with horizontals as heavy as verticals, a very hand-drawn look. Public Sans, a hefty sans-serif, grounds it, and that gap in lowercase height is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-ranade: Hand-traced and bold in character. Bellota's stylus-width strokes carry no hairlines or shadows, while Ranade, a sans-serif, lets its weight shift slightly and spaces its type widely, giving the pair a lively mix of drawn and organic.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-supreme: Bellota draws every stroke as if with one nib, hanging the ends of its s far from the spine for a distinctive heading. Supreme, a sans-serif with a heavy strip of text, holds its letters open and crisp.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-orbit: Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine and traces every stroke at one stylus width, so it looks distinctive. It earns its keep big and short, while Orbit stays a ropy, floating sans below.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-science-gothic: Hand-drawn and commanding, Bellota hangs its s ends far from the spine and keeps one stylus width everywhere. Science Gothic, a sans-serif with no thick-thin parts, lets Bellota earn its keep in big, short headings.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-syncopate: Syncopate holds its open c, e and s shapes with a technical-pen steadiness, spaced like rungs on a rope ladder. But Bellota, hanging its s ends far from the spine, brings the real character, a hand-traced contrast to the plain sans below.
